workPending: A profile save result needs checking
unchanged: No changes from the loaded profile
scopeHint: These indicators cover the profile fields and account language on this page. Changes stay in memory during this login; refreshing or leaving may lose them. Security and other settings have their own save actions.
failed: The profile could not be saved
failedHint: Your inputs are still here. Review them and choose Retry to send the current values.
unconfirmed: The profile save result is not confirmed
checkFailed: The saved profile could not be checked
different: The account profile differs from the submitted values
pendingHint: Your inputs stay here. Check the account before saving again. This check only reads the profile and does not resend it. The earlier save may still finish, so a different result alone does not mean it failed.
comparison: Compare the submitted and checked profile
continueConfirm: Continue editing with your current inputs? The checked account profile becomes the comparison point. The earlier request may still finish; review the account again before relying on its values. No new save will be sent now.
discardConfirm: Restore the last loaded or confirmed profile and its display language? The unsaved profile inputs will be discarded. This does not send a save request.
